name: What maintenance is required for a new concrete driveway?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for a new concrete driveway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper maintenance can extend the life of your new concrete driveway. It's recommended to seal the concrete approximately 30 days after installation and then every 2-3 years to protect against moisture, stains, and UV damage. Promptly clean up spills to prevent staining. Avoid using de-icing salts, as they can damage the concrete surface. Address any small cracks or issues early to prevent them from worsening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seal your driveway every 2-3 years, clean spills promptly, and avoid de-icing salts to extend its lifespan.
